sections.overview: This South American cichlid occurs in the Guaporé and Paraguay river systems.
sections.identification: FishBase reports a maximum published length of about 27.5 cm total length.
sections.habitat: It inhabits streams and lagoons with sandy or muddy bottoms.
sections.diet: It sifts sediment through its mouth to extract insect larvae, crustaceans and other food items.
sections.behavior: When feeding in small groups, individuals may watch for approaching piranhas, according to the cited field observation.
sections.reproduction: FishBase classifies the species as an ovophile mouthbrooder.
sections.ecology: Like S. mapiritensis, it is an eartheater cichlid in the genus Satanoperca, but its documented range is the Guaporé and Paraguay systems rather than the lower Orinoco; see the related profile.
sections.conservation: FishBase lists a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern, dated 2020.
